configurations.name: web
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 >/dev/null && BROWSER=none EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATOR=true npx expo start --web --port 8081 --clear

configurations.name: web-lite
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 >/dev/null && BROWSER=none EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATOR=true EXPO_PUBLIC_EDITION=lite npx expo start --web --port 8084 --clear

configurations.name: metro-native
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 >/dev/null && CI=1 EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATOR=true npx expo start --dev-client --port 8081 --clear
